LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_EnableBodyTinting: Recolor body silhouette based on dominant limbs
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_EnableBodyTinting_Desc: If enabled, the body doll silhouette is tinted with the color of the dominant installed limb prosthetics.
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_RequiredLimbCount: Minimum matching limbs required to tint body: {0} of 4
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_ColorBottomIcons: Recolor bottom hand and foot icons
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_ColorBottomIcons_Desc: If enabled, the bottom hand and foot icons are tinted with the color of the corresponding installed limb.
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_PaletteHint: Click a color box or the 'Palette...' button to pick a color in the color wheel/square:
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_PaletteTip: Click to open the color picker
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_UseDLCColors: Use dedicated colors for DLC implants
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_UseDLCColors_Desc: If enabled, implants from Royalty, Biotech, Anomaly, and Odyssey will use their own distinctive DLC colors instead of generic bionics.
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_OnlyShowOrgansInOrganMode: Show organs only in organ view mode
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_OnlyShowOrgansInOrganMode_Desc: If enabled, internal organs are hidden in overview mode and only displayed when the organ view tab is active.
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_SaveCustomTip: Save current color as custom preset
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_CustomSlotTip: LMB: Select | RMB: Overwrite with current color
LanguageData.NHT_YAPEM_CustomSlotEmptyTip: Empty slot — click to save current color
